faq_metaDescription: Common questions about {name}: who can see your region, what it costs, how to get your data out, and why there is no public side to it.

form_wmsUrlInvalid: Enter the full request URL, including its LAYERS parameter
install_body: Full screen, one tap from your home screen, and no browser bar in the way.
install_manualShare: Tap the share button in the browser bar
install_manualTitle: Add grnyte to your home screen
install_offlineBody: Install the app and the guidebook stays on your phone, ready at the crag with no signal.
invite_addressMismatch: You’re signed in as {current}. This invite is for {email}. Continue with that email, or ask {inviter} to invite the address you use.
invite_full: Ask {inviter} to free a seat, then open this link again.
invite_notFound: Check the link from your invitation email, or ask the person who invited you for a new one.
invite_notNow: Not now, this invitation stays in your settings
landing_ctaBody: Free, no card, no trial. Invite the people who should be there and nobody else.
landing_ctaTitle: Your first region takes about five minutes.
landing_featureGuidebookBody: Areas, sectors, blocks and routes with grades, conditions and descriptions. Structured, not a list of names.
landing_featureLogbookBody: Sessions, sends, projects and first ascents. The history of the area is built out of them.
landing_featureMapsBody: Every boulder and every parking spot on one map, so you don’t get lost searching for them.
landing_featureOfflineBody: Install it like an app. No signal at the boulders is the normal case, not the edge case.
landing_featurePrivateBody: A region is invisible until you’re invited into it. No public map, no search result, no crawler.
landing_featureTopoBody: Draw the line straight onto the photo of the boulder. As many photos and as many lines as the boulder needs.
landing_featuresTitle: Everything you expect from a bouldering app.
landing_footerDesc: An open-source guidebook and logbook for bouldering. Your region is visible only to the people you invite. Anyone can sign up and start one.
landing_heroCaption: Your boulders, your topos, your data
landing_heroSubtitle: Full area and topo management plus a complete logbook, tailored to bouldering. Visible only to the people in your region.
landing_heroTrust: Free · no commercial intent · made for climbers
landing_metaDescription: An open-source guidebook and logbook for bouldering. Areas, topos, maps and ascents, visible only to the people you invite. No public map, no search results.
landing_nameDefinitionRest: with the vowels chipped off. A home for the lines that aren’t on any public map.
landing_ogImageAlt: The grnyte logo beside the tagline Private topos for private crags, next to a phone showing a topo.
landing_peekPlatform: No app store. Open grnyte in your browser and add it to your home screen.
landing_peekTitle: Designed around your phone, right there at the boulders.
landing_shotLogbookCaption: Your sends and sessions, and your community’s activity.
landing_shotMapCaption: Every sector and every boulder in your region.
landing_shotTopoCaption: Every line on the boulder, colored by grade.
landing_stewardBody: Clubs, alpine club sections and the groups that negotiate access. A bigger group needs more than a signup form.
landing_stewardCta: Tell me what yours needs and we’ll work it out together.
landing_stewardTitle: I’ll set your region up with you.
landing_whyAccessBody: Access holds as long as the place stays hard to find.
landing_whyClose: grnyte is a guidebook and a logbook that never publishes. Areas, topos, maps and ascents, visible only to the people you invite.
landing_whyFragileBody: Traffic alone can close it, without anyone damaging anything.
landing_whyProjectBody: Projects still being worked, and not ready for anyone else yet.
landing_whyTitle: If an area can’t go public, it still deserves an organized guidebook.
legal_disclaimer_metaDescription: What the climbing information on {name} is, what it is not, and what nobody checks.
legal_imprint_metaDescription: Who runs {name}, the address for legal notices, and the contact points for users and authorities.
legal_privacy_metaDescription: What {name} stores about you, who processes it, and the rights you can exercise.
legal_report_metaDescription: How to report unlawful content on {name}, and how a landowner can raise an access or property objection.
legal_terms_metaDescription: The rules for using {name}: your content stays yours, the licence I need, and how liability works.

push_installFirst: Add the app to your home screen first. Notifications only work from there.
push_promptBody: Get notified when somebody mentions you, edits your ascent, or your community is busy.
push_testBody: Push is working on this device.
queryState_error: Something went wrong while loading this.
region_cannotChangeOwnRole: You can’t change your own role
region_capBody: That’s the limit for one account. Open one of them to rename or manage it.
region_capReached: You can start at most {count} regions.
region_deleteIntro: This deletes {region} and everything in it for every member: areas, blocks, routes, topos, media, comments and ascents. You can’t undo it.

match.countPlural=one: {count} other member loses access and gets an email.
match.countPlural=other: {count} other members lose access and get an email.

region_emptyBody: Give it its first area, one named place to climb, like a patch of forest or a crag.
region_emptyReadOnly: Nobody has added an area to this region yet.
region_handOverAdminOnly: Only an admin can become the owner. Make them an admin first.
region_handOverCapReached: They already own {count} regions. Nobody can own more.
region_handOverIntro: {name} becomes the owner of {region}. Only the owner can delete the region or hand it over. You stay an admin.
region_handOverNext: Press Hand over to make {name} the owner.
region_inviteAlreadyMember: That address is already a member of this region
region_inviteResendWait: Sent a moment ago. Wait before sending it again
region_leaveConfirm: Leave {name}? You lose access to everything in it until somebody invites you back.
region_live_body: Your first route is up. Invite your community and their ascents will show up here.
region_mapLayerAttributionsHint: One credit per line, shown in the map’s attribution box.
region_mapLayerUrlHint: Paste the full WMS request URL, with its query parameters.
region_mapLayersEmpty: No map layers yet. Add one to draw it over the map for everyone in this region.
region_mapLayersStale: The map layers changed while this page was open. Reopen it and make the change again.
region_mapLayersUnreadableBody: This version of the app can’t read all of this region’s map layers, and saving here would remove the ones it can’t. Updating the app may help.
region_mapLayersUnreadableTitle: Some of these map layers can’t be read
region_memberGone: They aren’t in this region anymore, or the link is out of date.
region_notMember: You are not a member of this region. Ask someone in it for an invitation.
region_ownerMustHandOver: You own this region. Hand it over to another admin first.
region_ownerOnly: Only the owner of this region can do that.
region_ownerProtected: The owner can’t be demoted or removed. Only they can hand the region over.
region_statsActivityHint: One bar per month. Several edits to the same thing within minutes count once.
region_tagComma: A tag can’t contain a comma
region_tagDuplicate: Each tag can only appear once
region_tagGone: That tag is no longer in this region’s list

match.countPlural=one: Remove “{name}”? It comes off {count} route, and that cannot be undone.
match.countPlural=other: Remove “{name}”? It comes off {count} routes, and that cannot be undone.

region_tagsEmpty: No tags yet. Add the ones your community uses to describe routes.
region_tagsHint: Renaming a tag keeps it on every route that already carries it.
region_tagsUnreadable: This version of the app can’t read all of this region’s tags, so they can’t be changed here.
region_tagsUnreadableBody: This version of the app can’t read all of this region’s tags, and saving here would replace the ones it can’t. Updating the app may help.
reports_alreadyReported: You reported this already. Sending again updates your report.
reports_dismissBody: It stays up. Everyone who reported it is told so, and their reports are deleted.
reports_dismissed: Dismissed. Everyone who reported it is told it stays up.
reports_legalHint: This report goes to the region’s admins. For a legal claim, you can also write to the operator.
reports_notFound: This is gone already, or you can’t report it.
reports_noteHint: Only the region’s admins read it, and they see that you sent it. Say what is wrong and where.
reports_ownHint: You added this, and no other admin can review it. You see only the rules named, never who reported or what they wrote.
reports_queueHint: What members reported in this region, newest first. Only admins see who reported. The person reported is never told who.
reports_sent: Sent. The region’s admins will review it.
routes_deleteNote: Removes its ascents and grade opinions too.
routes_drawOnTopo: Draw this route on a topo
routes_form_descriptionHint: Where does the line go, and how does it climb? A bit of history is welcome too.
routes_form_faHint: “Me” logs it under your profile. New names are fine and don’t need an account.
routes_form_gradeHint: A suggestion to get it started. Everyone who logs an ascent gives their opinion, and the grade settles on the average.
routes_form_mediaHint: Everything uploads in the background. You can save meanwhile.
routes_form_optionalNote: Everything here is optional. Add what you know, the community fills the gaps.
routes_form_rating0Hint: Most routes have none. That’s fine.
routes_form_rating3Hint: One of the best around. Worth travelling for.
routes_form_ratingGuide1: Quality of the rock and holds
routes_form_ratingGuideIntro: Rate the line, not your send. Weigh:
routes_form_similarAnnouncement: Routes with a similar name are listed below.
routes_form_similarExact: This block already has a route called “{name}”.
routes_form_similarHeading: Is your route one of these?
routes_listsStale: The tags or first ascensionists changed while this page was open. Reopen it and make the change again.
routes_moveTopoLinesChanged: This route's lines on the photo changed since you opened this. Check the move again.
routes_nameExists: A route named “{name}” already exists on this block
search_hint: Search areas, blocks, routes and people

settings_deleteAccountGoes: Your profile, your ascents with their photos and videos, your favorites, settings and notifications.
settings_deleteAccountIntro: Deleting your account takes effect at once. You can’t undo it.
settings_deleteAccountNext: Press Delete to delete your account.
settings_deleteAccountRegionsGone: Nobody else uses these regions, so they’re deleted with everything in them:
settings_deleteAccountStays: If other members still use a region, what you added there stays: the areas, blocks, routes, topos, photos and comments, and your updates in its feed. Each one shows “Deleted user” in place of your name.
settings_emailAlreadySent: We sent this code together with the first one, so it may already be waiting.
settings_emailChanged: Email changed. Your other devices are signed out.
settings_emailCodesResent: Both addresses got a new code. Start again with the one sent to your current address.
settings_emailIntro: We’ll send a code to your current address and one to the new address. You enter them one after the other.
settings_emailStepNew: Step 2 of 2 · Confirm the new address
settings_emailUnchanged: That is already your email address
settings_errorLogsHint: Grouped by message, newest first. Client and server.
settings_languageHint: Applies to emails and notifications too.
settings_mailForwardingOff: Mail to this address does not reach you
settings_mailForwardingOffBody: {address} is the private address Apple made for grnyte, and mail forwarding for it is turned off in your Apple ID. To use another address, first turn forwarding back on in your Apple ID settings under Sign in with Apple, then change the address here.
settings_mailForwardingOffSupportBody: {address} is the private address Apple made for grnyte, and mail forwarding for it is turned off. If your Apple ID still exists, turn forwarding back on in its settings under Sign in with Apple, then change the address here. If it does not, send us a message through Feedback while signed in, and we will help you move to another address.
settings_notifyAscentsHint: When somebody in your community logs a climb
settings_notifyCommentsHint: When somebody comments on an entry you wrote or joined
settings_notifyCommunityHint: When somebody joins or their role changes
settings_notifyDirectedHint: Mentions, changes to your ascents, your role
settings_notifyGuidebookEditsHint: New areas, blocks, routes, topos and photos
settings_notifyReactionsHint: When somebody reacts to something you logged or edited
settings_otherDevicesHint: Signs you out everywhere except here.
settings_passwordIntro: Confirm it’s you, then choose a new password. Saving signs out your other devices.
settings_pushTestFailed: The test notification didn’t reach this device.
settings_resumeLogEmpty: Nothing recorded yet. An entry appears when reopening the app needed a reconnect.
settings_resumeLogHint: Stored on this device only, never sent. Newest first.
settings_signInMethodsLastMethod: Set a password or add another method before removing {provider}.
settings_signInMethodsRelinks: You can still sign in with {provider}, because {provider} manages this address.
settings_signInMethodsRemovedSignedOut: {provider} removed. Your other devices are signed out.
settings_usernameTaken: Someone in your regions already uses this name
share_statusPrivate: Only people with access can see this.
share_statusPublic: Anyone with the link can view this.
share_turnOn: Turn on to share a link anyone can open.
status_reconnecting: Reconnecting. You might not see the latest changes.
topo_alreadyTopo: That image is already a topo
topo_deletePhotoConfirm: Delete this photo and its lines?
topo_deletePhotoSub: Remove this photo and its lines

topo_legacyReadOnly: This topo was drawn in an older format. You can’t edit it yet.

topo_noRoutesDrawn: No routes on this photo yet
topo_none: No topo for this block yet.

topo_routeNotOnBlock: That route is not on this block
